title: Parallel lines part
view: left: flat torus window following the pair, rotated so travel is to the right. Right: Poincare disk (the whole hyperbolic world, radius 4 kappa = 104 cells), nearest cell per pixel; the disk picture shrinks distances toward the rim, so both animals look smaller as they move out though they keep their size. Grey dots: each half's mass centre every 0.2 tu. The ring is the world's edge (absorbing: empty beyond).
caveats: The hyperbolic world is the {3,7} triangle tiling subdivided 25 times per edge (locally a hex lattice with seven-fold defects), kernel weights use exact cell areas, and kernel rows near the rim keep the interior normalisation (vacuum beyond, not renormalised).
The animals leave the world after about 30 tu; the separation law is measured until then (research/experiments/GEOM/pair.jsonl).

runs.world: {3,7} geodesic grid, kappa 26, radius 104 cells, Poincare disk
